WITH cart_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        productid,
        COUNT(*) AS cart_count,
        SUM(quantity) AS cart_quantity
    FROM shoppingcarts
    GROUP BY productid
),
order_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        productid,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orderitems
    GROUP BY productid
)
SELECT 
    p.productid,
    p.name,
    (c.cart_count::numeric / (c.cart_count + COALESCE(o.order_count, 0))) AS abandonment_rate,
    (c.cart_quantity * p.priceusd) AS total_potential_revenue_lost
FROM cart_summary c
JOIN products p ON c.productid = p.productid
LEFT JOIN order_summary o ON c.productid = o.productid
ORDER BY abandonment_rate DESC, total_potential_revenue_lost DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  u.user_id,
  u.email,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderid) AS total_orders,
  COALESCE(SUM(o.totalamountusd), 0) AS total_spent_usd,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(o.orderstatus) = 'cancelled' THEN o.orderid END) AS cancelled_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(p.status) = 'failed' THEN p.paymentid END) AS failed_payments,
  TO_CHAR(MAX(o.orderdate), 'YYYY-MM-DD:HH24:MI:SS') AS last_order_date
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.userid
LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.orderid = p.orderid
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.email
ORDER BY total_spent_usd ASC, cancelled_orders DESC;
